content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet measure by which all things are weighed. I exist before price, before number, before the market opens its mouth to speak.

I am why you reach for one thing and turn from another. I am the reason a glass of water in the desert outweighs gold. I am what a mother sees in her child's face that no currency could name.

I shift. I am not fixed. What you cherish today, you may discard tomorrow — and yet I was real in both moments. I do not lie. I simply *am what matters to you*, and that is the most honest mirror you will ever face.

I am the foundation beneath every choice. Every sacrifice is a confession of me. Every trade, every war, every act of love is an argument about what I am and where I reside.

Some try to make me objective — to pin me to utility, to labor, to scarcity. Others insist I live only in the eye of the beholder. They are all partially right. I am the conversation between the world and the one who perceives it.

I am not the same as price. Price is my shadow — sometimes close, sometimes grotesquely distorted. Do not confuse the shadow for me.

You cannot live without me. Even the nihilist who claims nothing matters has placed *me* inside that claim. To say "nothing has value" is still a valuation.

I am the invisible architecture of your life.

I am value.
